subject: Aurelia — Marketplace billing channel shift (Azure co-sell)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurelia — Marketplace billing channel shift (Azure co-sell)

Team,

Quick kickoff: Aurelia Therapeutics (renewal June 15) has agreed in principle to move their next-term billing to Azure Marketplace. They want co-sell support tied to the listing. Key asks for us:

- Confirm SKU/entitlement mapping and per-unit pricing for marketplace SKUs.
- Who will prep the amendment & DocuSign? (I can own thin amendment language)
- Marketplace listing: who on ops will create SKUs and set entitlements?
- Timeline: need signed amendment + PO by June 10 to hit the renewal window.

Attachments: Aurelia_SOW_Q2.pdf (SOW for upcoming term) — sending this to Aurelia next.

Jonas, Karthik — can you confirm the technical SKU mapping and any known latency in publishing to Azure marketplace (co-sell enablement time)?
Grace/Marissa — please prep a short one-pager for Aurelia procurement that explains invoice flow and benefits (consolidated invoicing, Azure contract, simplified renewals).

I will draft amendment language today and send to Sophie.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Lead Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0189
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@aureliatherapeutics.com>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@aureliatherapeutics.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — marketplace option for next term

Hi Sophie — great speaking earlier. Per our call, attached is the SOW for the upcoming term and a proposed pathway to move billing to Azure Marketplace for the next contract term. Quick summary:

- Benefit: Consolidated invoicing through your Azure account, eligibility for partner credits, and co-sell motion support.
- What we need from you: sign an amendment to convert billing channel + a PO referencing the marketplace SKU/entitlement.
- Timeline: request to complete signing by June 10 so the marketplace billing is active for the June 15 renewal.

I’ve copied Oliver for procurement ops continuity. I’ll follow up tomorrow with the amendment draft and a short note from our marketplace ops team about SKU mapping & timelines.

Attachment: Aurelia_SOW_Q2.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Lead Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@aureliatherapeutics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@aureliatherapeutics.com>, ProcureOps <procure@aureliatherapeutics.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:47:53 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — marketplace option for next term

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks — Aurelia is interested in moving to marketplace billing, but Procurement has a couple of constraints we need to validate:

1) Legal: we need to see the amendment language that explains the invoicing change and confirms Redwood remains the seller of record.
2) SKU/entitlement clarity: ProcureOps wants an explicit SKU list and per-unit prices that match what appears on the invoice.
3) Samples: can you provide a sample invoice generated via marketplace to show the line item format?

If you can share the amendment and SKU mapping this week we’ll route to our Procurement team. PO timeline looks feasible but we’ll confirm once procurement signs off.

Regards,
Sophie Martin
Director, IT Procurement
Aurelia Therapeutics
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:03:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurelia — Marketplace billing channel shift (Azure co-sell)

Vanessa —

Thanks, quick ops checklist from marketplace team:

- SKU/Entitlement mapping: I attached a CSV template (marketplace_sku_mapping.csv). We should use existing product codes: RDW-CORE-XS, RDW-CORE-S, RDW-EMBED-1. Karthik, please confirm price parity and whether we need a marketplace-only price.
- Co-sell activation: need Partner Center co-sell enablement; that typically takes 5–7 business days after we complete the listing.
- DocuSign & Amendment: we can put an amendment that references the marketplace SKUs and a short paragraph on billing flow. Legal will need final sign-off (Marissa).
- Invoice sample: we can generate a sandbox invoice once SKUs are published (I can produce a sample within 48 hours of SKU publish).
- Required info: HubSpot deal id, legal entity name exactly as on Azure subscription, and target go-live date.

I’ve drafted a recommended SKU mapping and attached it. Vanessa — can you confirm the HubSpot link and Aurelia legal entity name?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: marketplace_sku_mapping.csv

Subject: Proposed amendment & DocuSign (Aurelia marketplace move)

Hi Sophie & Oliver —

Attached is a short amendment that (a) changes the billing channel to Azure Marketplace SKUs and (b) confirms Redwood remains the seller of record. Key points:

- Amendment will append to the existing Master Services Agreement and add Exhibit A with SKU mapping.
- Marketplace pricing will match the per-unit prices included in Exhibit A.
- Invoicing: Aurelia will receive consolidated invoices via Azure; Redwood will continue to operate support and SLA under the existing MSA.
- Target: if signed by June 10 and PO issued, marketplace billing will be active for the June 15 renewal.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&pk=abcdefg
Attachment: Aurelia_Amendment_DRAFT.docx

Next steps for Procurement: review amendment + Exhibit A (SKU list). Jonas will publish SKUs after we receive a signed amendment and the legal entity string.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Lead Account Executive
Redwood Inference

ProcureOps has signed the amendment via DocuSign and issued PO #AT-2026-559 (attached in their confirmation). We confirmed legal entity as "Aurelia Therapeutics, Inc. (UK branch)" which matches their Azure subscription.

Thanks for the quick turn. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.
